routines.name: Dyn_Scene_RunCollisionPass
routines.contract: Complete 2061B, stack scene/RET4. Six actual profile caches and RDTSC scopes; dynamic-body x87 AABB refresh; broadphase vslots3/4/5/6; update receives *(scene+B0), not its address. Pair vector B4/B8/BC resized to total pair count, filtered prefix skips both-sleeping endpoints; inclusive task partitions with last remainder; actual scheduler; events always dispatched. Private context changes internal RET8; public source interface. Return-after-free C576B1..B3 restored under lock without changing callee noreturn; padding after JMP untouched.

Second pass captures next, removes empty manifold from both actual body vectors, unlinks and pushes free list C, decrements1D0. Actual pool EC head/F0 sentinel, headanchor10; old scene+B0 prose corrected to dereference. Native reload and stale-field behavior retained.

routines.name: Dyn_Scene_DispatchContactEvents
routines.contract: Complete 361B, stack scene/RET4. Signed scene DC count and D8 12B event records. Stack72B descriptor {shapeA,shapeB,worldPoints[4],normal,count}, initialized transformed point bytes ARE callback-visible. Native normal reads eventindex*30h+manifold+8, not always first contact. Listener at body68, ECX/vslot0/stack descriptor/RET4. Second callback reloads other body/listener, swaps shape words but does not negate normal or recompute points; first-callback descriptor mutations may persist. Unused point slots retain stack preimage; no memory-safety claim for arbitrary event indices.
